title: HH Blocked From Leaving Lusaka Airport
notes: The opened article identifies an airport travel obstruction while the UPND leader was travelling to a funeral. Its 8 January publication metadata plus “yesterday” and “Thursday” wording support 7 January for that incident. It reports no public gathering, public demand at the airport, or turnout, so this lead is excluded from event candidates; that does not establish that no other gathering occurred.

title: UPND sympathisers accompany Hichilema to Police Headquarters (December 2020 account)
notes: The 28 January legislative transcript recounts a Police Headquarters incident on 23 December 2020, outside this unit. The reviewed passages establish no January continuation. It says about 30 buses were used; vehicle count is not attendee count, so the 50-person threshold remains unknown. This is a physical-boundary exclusion and does not establish a January protest. Search-only contemporary press links S017–S022 were added as follow-up leads; their bylines/origins and relation to one another are not verified here, so they are not counted as independent corroboration. Only S016 was body-read for the December date.
